executive_summary: Getinge delivered solid Q2 2025 with 4.1% organic sales growth despite significant tariff and currency headwinds (SEK -270M impact). All business areas and regions showed positive growth. Paragonix acquisition contributing ahead of schedule. Management maintains positive outlook and unchanged 2025 guidance of 2-5% organic growth.
key_highlights: Paragonix contributing positively ahead of plan
Vasoview Hemopro 3 first clinical cases in US
Zimmer Biomet partnership for ASC segment

ceo_letter.author: Mattias Perjos
ceo_letter.title: President & CEO

promises.statement: Average adjusted earnings per share growth of above 12%
Net sales for 2025 expected to increase by 2-5% organically
Vasoview Hemopro 3 deliveries on larger scale during Q3

challenges.challenge: Tariff costs approximately SEK 110M in the quarter

honesty_signals: Acknowledges short-term absorption of tariff costs
Notes analyzing supply chain adaptation opportunities
Explicitly states geopolitical risk is elevated

key_quotes.quote: Considering the tariff levels noted in the second quarter, we see no need to change our long-term financial target.
Given our performance and dialogue with customers, my outlook for the remainder of 2025 is positive, even though geopolitical risk is elevated.
We are well positioned to manage these challenges by leveraging our leading position in key niches.

key_narratives: Stable organic growth across all business areas and regions
Successfully managing tariff headwinds through pricing
Paragonix integration ahead of schedule with margin contribution
Continued productivity focus driving expense reduction
mda_analysis.management_interpretation: Management frames Q2 as evidence of resilience despite external headwinds. The narrative emphasizes the company's ability to adapt to tariffs and currency while maintaining growth trajectory. Confidence in long-term targets remains high.

Acute Care Therapies.name: Acute Care Therapies
Acute Care Therapies.management_commentary: Strong ventilator demand. ECLS consumables order intake high. Paragonix celebrating 100th kidney transplant. Vasoview Hemopro 3 clinical cases successful.

Life Science.name: Life Science
Life Science.management_commentary: Sterile Transfer double-digit growth. Bio-Processing rationalization underway. New washer launched. Waiting for demand return in Bio-Processing.

Surgical Workflows.name: Surgical Workflows
Surgical Workflows.management_commentary: Sharp organic order intake increase. Infection Control and Digital Health driving growth. XEN cleaning products launched in US. Zimmer Biomet ASC partnership.

Full Intra-Aortic Balloon catheter portfolio EU MDR certified
XEN brand cleaning products launched in US

Life Science site 99.9% renewable energy milestone

Net debt increased after Paragonix acquisition

targets.notes: Long-term target maintained despite current tariff levels

guidance.commentary: Management explicitly stated no need to change long-term financial targets despite tariff headwinds. Outlook for remainder of 2025 is positive.
